summary: MDJM LTD reported the resignation of CFO Mengnan Wang effective September 1, 2026, citing personal reasons with no disagreement with company operations. The board appointed director Bo Wang as CFO the same day, filling the vacancy. Bo Wang, a CPA with auditing experience, continues as director without additional compensation. The 6-K filing details the abrupt CFO transition, a management change event. No financial terms, advisors, or transaction mechanics involved. Watch for further disclosures on the CFO transition's impact on financial reporting continuity.
